entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to return something? I'm a bit lost on how this works.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have an order number I can look up for you?
Um, yes, let me see... It was for that bike helmet. I think the number is VF-8675309. Is that right? I'm not sure.
Yes, I see it right here. It looks like the helmet was delivered about 78 days ago. What seems to be the issue with it?
Well, it's just... the color. It looked different on the website, and it doesn't match my bike at all. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. I just don't know what to do.
I understand completely. Let me just quickly review our return policy for you.
Oh no, is it too late? The policy page was so confusing to me. Can't you just help me? I don't want to be stuck with it.

There's no need to worry. Our policy for standard items like this helmet allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. Since you're at 78 days and the box is unopened, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief. Thank you!

Of course. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied, especially with something as important as your safety gear. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you now and will send it to the email address on file. Is that okay?
Yes, that's perfect. Thank you so much for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. You've been a great help.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
